title: Nay's Enhanced Create
description: A Create Heavy modpack made for Fabric 1.20.1
body:
Nay's Enhanced Create is a modpack fully based arround upgrading the Create mod.

It is the Fourth Modpack of the "Nay's Enhanced" Series.

It's main objective is to add even more possibilities to the create mod to expend furthermore on what's possible with this modpack.

It also helps access and discover Create with some new structures to help new players & older players access ressources of the mod more easily

It also adds other content to improve vanilla but those are more Quality of Life mods than full on add-ons to the modpack.

Here are some in game screenshots to showcase more of the modpack :

Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Modpack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Error Messages, Game Not Launching, Specific mods crashing the game...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
